items.title: Datadog (DDOG) Partners With Cloudaware To Bring LogSight To Its Marketplace
items.summary: Datadog and Cloudaware have partnered to list Cloudaware LogSight on the Datadog Marketplace. The integration aims to give Datadog clients wider cloud log coverage and stronger visibility across multi cloud environments. The new offering focuses on automated discovery and onboarding of previously unmonitored log sources to support monitoring and compliance needs.
